title: Cricket Data Scientist
description:
Cricket Data Scientist – Sports Betting Consultancy

Location: London(hybrid)
Salary: Competitive base + highly lucrative bonus scheme
Level: Mid–Senior (flexible depending on experience)

We're working with a well-established sports betting consultancy looking to hire a Cricket Data Scientist to join their growing team.

This is an excellent opportunity to work on challenging predictive modelling projects, using advanced statistical techniques and machine learning to develop models that directly influence betting decisions across global cricket markets.

The business offers a fantastic working culture, excellent employee retention and a highly rewarding compensation structure.


Requirements

  • Strong hands-on Data Science and predictive modelling experience.
  • Excellent Python skills, including libraries such as pandas, Polars and scikit-learn.
  • Experience applying statistical techniques and machine learning to real-world datasets.
  • Cricket modelling experience strongly preferred, although candidates with relevant modelling experience in other sports will be considered.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of modelling projects.
  • Genuine interest in cricket and sports analytics.


What's on Offer?

  • Competitive base salary, flexible depending on experience.
  • Highly lucrative performance-related bonus scheme.
  • Interesting, technically challenging projects with a direct impact on betting decisions.
  • Excellent culture, strong employee retention and a highly skilled team.


If you have a strong background in predictive modelling and a passion for cricket, we'd love to hear from you –
